header.rule: Winning a trick scores nothing. All it earns is the right to draw one card from the stock -- so while you keep winning, your hand never shrinks. Run out of cards and you are out; the last player still holding cards wins. You are dealt as many cards as there are players (four each at a four-player table), and the rest is the stock.
header.noStock: The stock is empty. Nobody can refill now -- eliminations come quickly from here.

result.you: You win! You held cards longest.
result.eliminated: You are out. The remaining players will finish it between them.

hint.lingerlongerWinTrick: This card takes the trick, and taking it draws you a replacement.
hint.lingerlongerNoStock: This takes the trick, but the stock is empty so there is no refill. Still worth taking.
hint.lingerlongerDuck: You cannot take this trick, so play a low card.

tutorial.rule: **Winning a trick scores nothing.** All it earns is **one card from the stock**. Because your hand does not shrink while you keep winning, high cards are simply good here.
tutorial.goal: **Run out of cards and you are out; the last player still holding cards wins.** It is the exact inverse of a shedding game -- lingering is the whole point.
tutorial.stock: **Once the stock is empty nobody can refill.** From there every hand only shrinks, so eliminations come quickly. The count is always on screen.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Playable cards get a green ring. You must follow the suit that was led.
